title: Deterministic oracle machine as a nondeterministic machine
statement: Every oracle Turing machine with $k$ ordinary work tapes determines an oracle nondeterministic Turing machine with the same initial, query, positive-answer, and negative-answer states, whose transition function is independent of the nondeterministic choice bit and agrees with the original transition function.
